verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, and separately describes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. However, a probe found no downloadable spec at any common path (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc. all returned 404). That leaves it unconfirmed that a machine-readable file can actually be downloaded. The probe does not test the documented /api location, so it does not contradict the vendor claim. Missing for 10: a confirmed downloadable OpenAPI file URL, independent or hands-on verification that the spec can be fetched, and documentation of how to download it.
